title: Text Adventure

content.title: Your Mission
content.body:
Build a text adventure game where the player makes choices that change the story.

Your game should:
• Welcome the player and ask for their name
• Describe a place or situation
• Give the player at least two choices using input()
• Take a different path depending on what they choose
• Have a win condition AND a game-over condition

content.title: Story Ideas
content.body:
• You wake up in a haunted house. Do you explore the basement or run outside?
• You're an astronaut and your ship is losing power. Which system do you fix first?
• You find a magic door. Do you knock, open it quietly, or walk away?

Pick any idea — or invent your own!

starterCode:
# 🗺️ Text Adventure
# Write your story here!

print("Welcome to my adventure game!")
name = input("What is your name? ")
print("Hello,", name, "- let the adventure begin!")

# Describe the scene
print("You are standing at a crossroads in a dark forest.")

# Give the player a choice
choice = input("Do you go left or right? ")

if choice == "left":
    print("You find a cozy cottage. You win!")
else:
    print("You fall into a ditch. Game over!")
progressiveHints: Use input() to ask the player questions. Store the answer in a variable.
Use if/else to send the player on different paths based on their answer.
Add more choices by nesting if statements inside each branch.
Use print() to describe each scene vividly — make the player feel they're really there!
For extra fun, add a score variable and increase it when the player makes good choices.

milestones.label: Uses input() to ask the player something
Stores a value in a variable
Uses if to make a decision
Has multiple print() calls to tell the story

remixIdeas: Add a third choice at the start — what happens down the middle path?
Give the player a health or score counter that changes based on choices.
Add a secret password that unlocks a hidden ending.
Use a loop so the player can keep making choices until they win or lose.
Add a character (a wizard, a robot, a cat) who gives advice using print().
